verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official CLI, firebase-tools, documented at firebase.google.com/docs/cli. It deploys code and assets, serves Hosting locally, interacts with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. `login:ci` generates tokens for non-interactive environments, which suits agent and automation use, and a community user calls the CLI a huge feature. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances such as machine-readable/JSON output, and any documented link between the CLI and the MCP server or AI workflows.
